## Wakt 2.1.0

- **Force stop protection.** Wakt can register as a device admin (no policies) so Android greys out "Force stop" and refuses "Uninstall" until it is deactivated. Enable it from Settings or the new optional onboarding page; it cannot be turned off while a commitment lock, lock session or locked filter pause is running.
- Includes the Android 16 (API 36) target and signed `.aab` from 2.0.0.
